bluf: Pro Web Consulting is an Italian SEO consultancy whose site was unreachable at collection, so the whole record is a LinkedIn ad library reading: 20 company ads under the name Pro Web Digital Consulting, paid for by Cerved Group S.p.A., which the library names as owner, a sampled ad running Oct 8 to Nov 25, 2025. What it is doing, on that evidence, is lead capture: a free SEO Insights site check-up and an ad asking whether AI systems would cite the prospect's brand. Horus reads it Neutral at -5, best placed for KJ2, most exposed to KJ9; Monsoon reads Landfall at 75.6, the book buying on price. A rival should know: no client, no service page, no price and no house could be read, and the owner is a data group, not an agency.
doing:
The positioning line, an Italian SEO consultancy promoting a free SEO Insights site check-up and AI citation visibility, is itself reconstructed from LinkedIn ads because the site was unreachable, and the record holds no headline claim. Decoded, it is an SEO lead funnel: a free, two minute check-up of whether a site is losing visitors as the entry offer, with an AI citation question as the hook.

The sold mix is thin by construction. No services were captured. SEO scores 2 on the ads pushing SEO Insights, AI Search / GEO scores 1 on the ad asking whether the AI systems that choose whom to cite would list the prospect or leave it at the margins of the conversation, and every other capability scores 0; breadth is 2, with SEO the only core line and no lead line. One proprietary item is listed, SEO Insights, the free check-up tool. No partners, offices, CMS, founding year or headcount are recorded, and the confidence of the record is low.

AI posture: an AI visibility offer is hinted at by the ads and no service page confirms it, so Horus marks P1 partial. The one move is undated: the LinkedIn ad library names Cerved Group as owner and payer of its ads, with the deal type and date not shown. No news items, case studies or job postings are on record.

Pricing: the free check-up is the entry offer and no prices are shown; P5 unknown. Conspicuously absent for an SEO consultancy: the site itself, which means no sitemap, no publishing cadence, no llms.txt reading, no client list, no case study and no proof of the AI citation offer beyond a question in an ad.
clients:
The record names no client. The needs read counts 0 entries, no evidence types and no shared clients, no verticals are listed, and the client type is null, so nothing here can be tied to another tracked agency's book or to a sector.

What can be read about the buyer comes from the ads themselves, which address the owner of a site in Italian: one asks whether the prospect wants its site to bring greater results and offers SEO Insights free to understand how; another gives 2 minutes to find out whether the site is losing visitors; a third asks whether, if the AI systems had to choose whom to cite today, the prospect would be on the list or at the margins of the conversation. That is a self serve SEO diagnostic aimed at site owners worried about traffic loss and AI citation, inferred from the ads and nothing else. The owner named in the ad library, Cerved Group S.p.A., is the other clue to the base, and the record says nothing about how the two books relate.

What the base needs next, read against KJ2 (ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them, but the price and the proof are still unsettled) and KJ3 (discovery fragments at the assistant layer and re-concentrates at the distribution layer): the prospects those ads reach are likely, at low confidence, to want the citation question answered with a number, which the record shows no audited product to give (P1 partial). Read against KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better), SEO buyers sold a free check-up are likely to ask what the paid work measures, and the record is silent on that too. Every judgment here rests on 20 ads.
house: The house could not be read: the site was unreachable at collection, so the sitemap count, content velocity in 90 and 365 days, AI topic URLs, llms.txt, CMS, tag stack, social pixels, test tools and ABM stack are all null in the record, and the one test, publishing cadence, is unknown because it was not measured. No AI crawlers are recorded as blocked, which is an absence of a reading, not an open door. Google ad presence is unread (Transparency Center lookup blocked). LinkedIn is the only observed channel: 20 single image company page ads and 0 thought leader ads, accepted under Pro Web Digital Consulting (Cerved Group S.p.A.), one detail page showing the ad paid for by Cerved Group and running Oct 8 to Nov 25, 2025; the lines sell the free SEO Insights check-up and pose the AI citation question. No Meta or TikTok reading exists and no social links are listed. Horus records no say/do integrity score.
market:
Horus scores Pro Web Consulting a tailwind index of -5.4, band Neutral (percentile 12, resilience 35.8), sold mix at 16:36 on the Solar Arc, dusk. Best placed for KJ2, ads inside AI answers (net 0.292, AI Search / GEO +1), and KJ3, discovery fragments at the assistant layer and re-concentrates at the distribution layer (net 0.292). Most exposed to KJ9, measurement gets worse before it gets better (net -0.583, SEO -1), and KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out (net -0.45, SEO -1). Best fit: The Toll Road, 83/100, the strongest scenario fit in this batch, on a mix that is almost all SEO. It is partial on P1; P2, P6 and P7 are absent; P5 is unknown; P3, P4 and P8 do not apply.

Monsoon scores 75.6, band Landfall, percentile 97: migration 75.6 and displacement 75.6, the same figure, a book read as buying on price with hours that move. 76 of the index is the sold mix, SEO (60) and AI Search / GEO (16); no adjustment terms apply. The work would go 40% to Eastern Europe, 35% to South and Southeast Asia and 15% to Africa and the Maghreb. The footprint is inferred: no hub offices, no onshore claims.
openings:
The strongest opening is price against pure SEO hours. Monsoon reads Landfall at 75.6 with displacement 75.6 and SEO carrying 60 of the index, and the record shows no pricing beyond a free check-up (P5 unknown). An offshore delivered rival that prices Italian SEO retainers in public is very likely, at moderate confidence, to undercut an owner funded lead funnel line by line; the falsifier is a reachable prowebconsulting.it showing a broader mix, named clients or a published price, any of which would change the breadth of 2 that drives this read.

The second opening is the citation question without the answer. The ads ask whether AI would cite the prospect and the record shows no audited AI visibility product (P1 partial) and no feed, schema or entity work (P2 absent), so a rival that runs the same question and returns a citation share number and the machine readable fix leads with what Pro Web only asks. The exposure to press is KJ9: an SEO only mix with no data or measurement line is unhedged as measurement worsens. No client can be contested because none is on record; the contestable thing is the funnel, prospects who took a free check-up from an ad paid for by Cerved Group between Oct 8 and Nov 25, 2025, and the record is silent on whether the ads still run.
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, reads in October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would move KJ6, one of the two judgments it is most exposed to.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, is a rolling indicator: the next milestone ($2B) and its timing, and pricing below $20 CPM, test the KJ2 tailwind that is the only one this mix is placed for.
Follow up the site: prowebconsulting.it was unreachable at collection, and a reachable crawl would supply services, clients, cadence and llms.txt, the whole missing half of this record.
Follow up the undated Cerved Group ownership named in the LinkedIn ad library for a deal type and date, and check whether the SEO Insights ads that ran Oct 8 to Nov 25, 2025 have been renewed.
